about: Hosted BM worksheets. Each entry becomes w/<id>.json, opened at https://biotechadamnazir.github.io/kloz/#w=<id>. Settings mirror Kloz Studio: pref = word classes (KN, KK, KA, KT or sub-types), lens = pw, pb, kt, tb; fin/fout = gaps forced in/out by Studio key (u<unit> or L<lens index>). No student names here: this repo is public.

worksheets.note: Perihal essay; gaps on word choice and kata sendi (selama, mendirikan, membawa, menimba, dari/daripada). Decoys are near-misses.
Same sheet, with Tunjuk jawapan after checking (for review after the first attempt).
